title: Change the details of your vehicle
summary: You can change your vehicle's details by submitting a request at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
You can change your vehicle's details at a Service NSW Centre, including:

The changes may need to be verified by an authorised examiner, or other Transport for NSW official, before the changes are recorded.
what_you_need: Your current Certificate of Registration or vehicle registration details
The appropriate inspection report or certificate (may be required depending on the change)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your change request.

more_info.text: Historical odometer data cannot be changed. You can refer to the vehicle’s logbook and service history to get historical readings.

external_links.text: Road vehicle descriptor online system – Transport for NSW

internal_links.text: Get help with a vehicle Defect Notice

faqs.q: What documents do I need to change my vehicle's details?
faqs.a: You will need the 'Change of Records' PDF form, your current Certificate of Registration or vehicle registration details, proof of identity, payment (if applicable), and the appropriate inspection report or certificate (if required).

faqs.q: Do I always need an inspection report?
faqs.a: No, you may not need an inspection report, for example, if you are only changing your vehicle’s colour.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my change request?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your change request.
